sources.ways: manus-output/birchie-osm/birchington.json (Overpass, OSM base 2026-05-03): cycleway, path, bridleway, track, footway; kept only where cycling is allowed (bicycle=no/dismount/private, access=no/private/agricultural, and public footpaths without bicycle=yes left out)
sources.crossings: Overpass query 2026-10-12 (OSM base 2026-10-11T22:57Z) of crossing and traffic-signal nodes on and within 25 m of the A28, saved as osm-download/a28-crossings.json

rules.trunk: never ride an edge of class trunk (the A28)
rules.sides: at each node in a28Junctions, pass only between neighbours listed on the same side; the two sides join only at a crossing below
rules.crossings: lights (pelican, signalled crossing, traffic-light junction) or a zebra, on the 30-40 mph stretches; the 1.7 km dual carriageway west of Brooksend has no bridge or tunnel, so no crossing there
rules.snapping: path ends and vertices joined to the game graph within 4 map px (14 m); crossings reach the nearest road on each side within 60 m of pavement
rules.weights: cycleway/path/bridleway/footway x1.0, track x2.2 (as the router weights track), snap-link and farm-link x1.0, crossing = pavement length
